subject: Game Theory
title: Deepfake Democracy
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Deepfake Democracy.

hook.text: A perfect deepfake of a president declaring war goes viral. By the time it's debunked, markets have crashed.

buildup.text: Cheap deepfakes create a trust dilemma: if any video might be fake, all video evidence loses credibility.

discovery.text: This enables the 'liar's dividend': real scandals get dismissed as deepfakes. Truth loses its power.

twist.text: Detection tools exist but face an arms race: each detection advance spurs better fakes. Defense always trails offense.

climax.text: Cryptographic provenance—signing video at capture—could create verifiable chains of truth. A new trust institution.

punchline.text: When nothing looks fake, everything does.

quiz.question: What is the 'liar's dividend' from deepfakes?
options: Real evidence gets dismissed as potentially fake
